qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive state-granted franchise territory with unreplicable underground transmission and distribution network across New York City and Westchester County, operating under rate-base regulation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet). While ConEd possesses an unreplicable T&D network monopoly across New York City and Westchester County, its regulated capital structure is structurally leveraged (LT debt/NI of 12.6x, interest coverage 2.38x) with 5-year median ROIC capped at ~5.2%. Perpetual capex requirements make it structurally dependent on external debt capital markets (kindness of strangers).
qualitative.evidence: 10-year GAAP ROIC median of 5.21% (2025: 4.89%, 2024: 5.21%, 2022: 4.79%). Long-term debt of $25.55B against TTM net income of $2.02B yields 12.6x debt-to-earnings leverage, far above the 4.0x maximum. EBIT of $2.94B covers interest of $1.23B at only 2.38x (below 5.0x threshold). Regulated rate-base ROE capped at 6-8% with continuous multi-billion capex requiring debt market access.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
